Bible by Hand helps you make the whole Bible your own, one chapter a day — reading it aloud, typing it and writing it by hand. There are no accounts, ads or analytics; what you write stays on your phone. Made by an independent developer for churchgoers of every age.

Korean Revised Version (개역한글, 1961) — its copyright term has ended. King James Version (1611) — public domain (Crown patent in the UK). World English Bible Updated — public domain, unchanged ("World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org). Texts from the CrossWire SWORD modules and eBible.org.

Gustave Doré, illustrations for the Bible (1866), and Julius Schnorr von Carolsfeld, Die Bibel in Bildern (1860), and historical sources such as the Codex Sinaiticus (4th century) — public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
